summary.en: Turning interested people into paying customers, and testing what works.
summary.bs: Kako zainteresovane ljude pretvoriti u kupce i testirati šta radi.

concepts.youtubeQuery: what is a lead in sales and marketing

en.one: A lead is a person or company that has shown interest and left a way to contact them.
en.explain: They filled in a form, asked for a quote, signed up for a newsletter or called. A qualified lead also fits your target market and has a real need and budget. Marketing creates leads; sales turns them into customers.
en.example: A solar panel installer gets 40 quote requests a month from its website. Those are leads; 8 of them sign a contract.
en.why: Counting leads and where they come from shows which marketing really works.
en.mixup: A lead is not a customer yet. Many leads are just curious, so follow up quickly and politely.

bs.one: Lead (potencijalni kupac) je osoba ili firma koja je pokazala interes i ostavila način da je kontaktiraš.
bs.explain: Popunili su formular, tražili ponudu, prijavili se na newsletter ili nazvali. Kvalifikovan lead se uz to uklapa u tvoje ciljno tržište i ima stvarnu potrebu i budžet. Marketing stvara leadove; prodaja ih pretvara u kupce.
bs.example: Montažer solarnih panela dobije 40 zahtjeva za ponudu mjesečno sa sajta. To su leadovi; 8 njih potpiše ugovor.
bs.why: Kad brojiš leadove i odakle dolaze, vidiš koji marketing stvarno radi.
bs.mixup: Lead još nije kupac. Mnogi su samo radoznali, pa se javi brzo i pristojno.

en.one: Conversion rate is the share of people who take the action you want, such as buying or signing up.
en.explain: Divide the number who did it by the number who had the chance, and multiply by 100. Typical online shops convert 1–3% of visitors. Raising conversion is often cheaper than buying more traffic.
en.example: 2,000 people visit your shop page and 40 buy. Conversion rate = 40 ÷ 2,000 = 2%.
en.why: Going from 2% to 3% means 50% more sales from the same visitors and the same ad budget.
en.mixup: A high conversion rate isn't always good. If you only show your page to people who were going to buy anyway, you are not growing.

bs.one: Conversion rate (stopa konverzije) je udio ljudi koji urade željenu radnju, npr. kupe ili se prijave.
bs.explain: Podijeli broj onih koji su to uradili s brojem onih koji su imali priliku i pomnoži sa 100. Tipični web shopovi pretvore 1–3% posjetilaca. Podizanje konverzije je često jeftinije od kupovine više posjeta.
bs.example: 2.000 ljudi posjeti stranicu shopa, 40 kupi. Stopa konverzije = 40 ÷ 2.000 = 2%.
bs.why: Prelazak s 2% na 3% znači 50% više prodaje od istih posjetilaca i istog budžeta za reklame.
bs.mixup: Visoka konverzija nije uvijek dobra. Ako stranicu pokazuješ samo onima koji bi ionako kupili, ne rasteš.

en.one: A call to action is the clear instruction that tells people what to do next: 'Book now', 'Get a quote', 'Add to cart'.
en.explain: Every ad, page or email should have one main CTA that is easy to see and specific. Too many choices, or none at all, leave people unsure, and they leave.
en.example: A hairdresser's Instagram bio changes from just an address to 'Book your cut in 30 seconds →' with a booking link. Bookings rise.
en.why: People are busy. A clear next step turns interest into action.
en.mixup: 'Click here' is not a good CTA. Say what they get: 'Get my free price list'.

bs.one: Call to action (poziv na akciju) je jasna uputa šta ljudi trebaju uraditi dalje: 'Rezerviši sada', 'Zatraži ponudu', 'Dodaj u korpu'.
bs.explain: Svaka reklama, stranica ili mejl treba imati jedan glavni CTA koji je lako vidljiv i konkretan. Previše izbora ili nijedan ostavljaju ljude nesigurnim, pa odu.
bs.example: Frizerka u Instagram opisu umjesto samo adrese stavi 'Rezerviši šišanje za 30 sekundi →' s linkom. Rezervacije porastu.
bs.why: Ljudi su zauzeti. Jasan sljedeći korak pretvara interes u akciju.
bs.mixup: 'Klikni ovdje' nije dobar CTA. Reci šta dobijaju: 'Preuzmi besplatni cjenovnik'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: what is a landing page explained

en.one: A landing page is a single web page made for one goal, usually where people land after clicking an ad or email.
en.explain: Unlike a home page with many links, a landing page focuses on one offer: a strong headline, the main benefits, proof like reviews, and one CTA. It should match the ad that brought people there.
en.example: An ad says 'First yoga class free'. It leads to a page with that exact offer, three reviews, a photo of the studio and a 'Book my free class' button.
en.why: Sending ad traffic to a focused page instead of your home page can double conversions.
en.mixup: Don't send ad clicks to your home page. People have to search again for the offer, and many give up.

bs.one: Landing page (odredišna stranica) je jedna web stranica napravljena za jedan cilj, obično tamo gdje ljudi dođu nakon klika na reklamu ili mejl.
bs.explain: Za razliku od početne stranice s mnogo linkova, landing page se fokusira na jednu ponudu: jak naslov, glavne koristi, dokaz kao recenzije i jedan CTA. Treba se poklapati s reklamom koja je dovela ljude.
bs.example: Reklama kaže 'Prvi čas joge besplatno'. Vodi na stranicu s tačno tom ponudom, tri recenzije, slikom studija i dugmetom 'Rezerviši besplatni čas'.
bs.why: Slanje posjeta s reklama na fokusiranu stranicu umjesto početne može udvostručiti konverzije.
bs.mixup: Ne šalji klikove s reklama na početnu stranicu. Ljudi moraju ponovo tražiti ponudu, a mnogi odustanu.

en.one: A/B testing means showing two versions of something to similar groups at the same time and seeing which works better.
en.explain: Change one thing only, for example the headline, price display or button text. Split visitors randomly between A and B. Wait until you have enough results before deciding, or the difference may be pure luck.
en.example: Version A says 'Free delivery', version B says 'Delivered tomorrow'. After 4,000 visitors, B gets 25% more orders.
en.why: It replaces opinions with evidence, so small improvements add up over time.
en.mixup: Ten clicks is not a test. With too few visitors, the 'winner' is often just random noise.

bs.one: A/B testing (A/B testiranje) znači pokazati dvije verzije nečega sličnim grupama u isto vrijeme i vidjeti koja radi bolje.
bs.explain: Promijeni samo jednu stvar, npr. naslov, prikaz cijene ili tekst dugmeta. Nasumično podijeli posjetioce između A i B. Sačekaj dovoljno rezultata prije odluke, inače razlika može biti čista sreća.
bs.example: Verzija A kaže 'Besplatna dostava', verzija B 'Dostava sutra'. Nakon 4.000 posjetilaca, B dobije 25% više narudžbi.
bs.why: Zamjenjuje mišljenja dokazima, pa se mala poboljšanja s vremenom saberu.
bs.mixup: Deset klikova nije test. S premalo posjetilaca 'pobjednik' je često samo slučajnost.

en.one: A sales pipeline is a simple list of all open deals and which stage each one is in.
en.explain: Typical stages: new lead, contacted, needs understood, offer sent, negotiation, won or lost. A CRM tool or even a spreadsheet tracks it. It shows how much future income is likely and where deals get stuck.
en.example: An IT firm has 12 offers sent worth €60,000. If it usually wins 1 in 4, it can expect about €15,000.
en.why: A pipeline helps you forecast sales and know when to look for more leads before income dries up.
en.mixup: A full pipeline is not money in the bank. Old deals nobody has touched in months should be cleaned out.

bs.one: Sales pipeline (prodajni pipeline) je jednostavan spisak svih otvorenih poslova i faze u kojoj je svaki.
bs.explain: Tipične faze: novi lead, kontaktiran, potrebe shvaćene, ponuda poslana, pregovori, dobijen ili izgubljen. Prati se CRM alatom ili čak tabelom. Pokazuje koliko budućeg prihoda je vjerovatno i gdje poslovi zapnu.
bs.example: IT firma ima 12 poslanih ponuda vrijednih 60.000 €. Ako obično dobije 1 od 4, može očekivati oko 15.000 €.
bs.why: Pipeline ti pomaže da predvidiš prodaju i znaš kad tražiti nove leadove prije nego prihod presuši.
bs.mixup: Pun pipeline nije novac na računu. Stare poslove koje niko nije dirao mjesecima treba očistiti.

q.bs: Gdje plaćena reklama treba slati ljude?

options.en: A landing page that matches the ad
options.bs: Na odredišnu stranicu koja se poklapa s reklamom

explain.en: A focused page with the same offer and one CTA converts much better.
explain.bs: Fokusirana stranica s istom ponudom i jednim CTA-om pretvara mnogo bolje.

q.en: In an A/B test, how many things should you change at once?
q.bs: U A/B testu, koliko stvari mijenjaš odjednom?

explain.en: Change one thing, so you know what caused the difference.
explain.bs: Promijeni jednu stvar, da znaš šta je izazvalo razliku.

q.en: €60,000 in open offers, and you usually win 1 in 4. What can you expect?
q.bs: 60.000 € u otvorenim ponudama, a obično dobiješ 1 od 4. Šta možeš očekivati?
